tools.name: normalize
tools.description: Deterministic text normalization: Unicode NFKC, zero-width/bidi stripping, smart-quote and dash folding, whitespace collapse, case folding. Returns a stable content hash so two texts can be compared for exact equality. $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, client-paid); failed calls are not charged

tools.name: validate
tools.description: Validate and canonicalize one identifier: email, URL, E.164 phone, IBAN (mod-97), payment card (Luhn), UUID, SHA-256, git SHA, EVM address (EIP-55) or domain. Returns {valid, canonical, fingerprint}. $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, client-paid); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Extract structured fields from unstructured text with byte offsets and normalized values: emails, URLs, IPv4, phones, money amounts, ISO dates, UUIDs, EVM addresses, SKUs, semver. $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, client-paid); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: redact
tools.description: Redact PII from text before it is stored or logged. Returns redacted text plus exact byte spans and counts per class: credit_card, iban, email, private_key, evm_address, phone, ipv4, url. $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, client-paid); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: classify
tools.description: Rule-based multi-label text classification over a fixed taxonomy (urgency, financial_promise, credential_request, crypto_mention, cta, legal_offer, medical_claim, seo_spam, url_shortener, press_release, question, has_contact). Deterministic - identical text always yields identical labels. $0.003 USD

tools.name: dedupe
tools.description: Near-duplicate detection across a batch of documents. Exact Jaccard similarity over word-3-shingle sets decides duplication; a 64-bit SimHash is returned per document as a compact content fingerprint. Up to 200 documents per call. $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, client-paid); failed calls are

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Line-level LCS diff of two text blobs. Returns a structured edit script with insertions, deletions, unchanged line counts and per-operation metadata; with format='unified' also returns a unified-diff string. $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, client-paid); failed calls are not charged.

tools.name: chunk
tools.description: Split long text into pieces for RAG retrieval. Strategies: 'sentence' packs whole sentences into a size budget and never splits mid-sentence; 'paragraph' prefers \n\n boundaries; 'fixed' is a hard char window with overlap. The highest-value endpoint for agents that build retrieval pipelines. $0.005

tools.name: extract_custom
tools.description: Pull caller-defined structured fields from text using regex patterns with deterministic type coercion. Supported types: string, bool, date, url, email, number. Returns {fields: {name: value|null}, found, missing}. Pure deterministic — no LLM call. $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, client-paid);

tools.name: validate_json
tools.description: Deterministic JSON-Schema subset validator. Catches malformed JSON before it breaks a pipeline. Supports: type, required, properties, items, minLength, maxLength, pattern, enum, minimum, maximum, additionalProperties. No external dependencies. $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, client-paid); fai

tools.name: slugify
tools.description: URL-safe slug from arbitrary text. NFKD-decomposes unicode (é -> e), lowercases, replaces every non-[a-z0-9] run with a separator, strips leading/trailing separators, truncates on separator boundaries (never mid-word). $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, client-paid); failed calls are not charged

tools.name: hash
tools.description: Content-addressable hashing for caching and dedup. Three algorithms: sha256 (via node:crypto / Web Crypto), xxhash64 and murmur3 (inline pure-JS, deterministic across runs). Returns hex digest + algorithm + byte count. $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, client-paid); failed calls are not charged

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "batch" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Run up to 10 primitive calls in one round trip. One x402 payment of $0.40 (=$0.04 per call, 20% off the single-call price). Each request specifies an `endpoint` (normalize, validate, extract, redact, classify, dedupe, diff, chunk, extract_custom, validate_json, slugify, hash) and the input for it; t" → after: "Run up to 10 primitive calls in one round trip. One x402 payment of $0.02 (=$0.0020 per call) — below the priciest single-call route ($0.01). Each request specifies an `endpoint` (normalize, validate, extract, redact, classify, dedupe, diff, chunk, extract_custom, validate_json, slugify, hash) and t"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
